environment_design.service_model: file-driven planning task with no hidden service
data_properties: deterministic store scaling and short-history launch item setup
separate inventory, open receipt, promotion, vendor, and analog inputs

principles: State the planner-facing goal and required deliverables first.
List the authoritative inputs, including store-status and open-receipt files, without spelling out every calculation step.
Keep formula detail out of the task statement when it can live in the policy file or the skill.
Express tradeoffs as business review capacity and priority rules instead of hidden math requirements.
Ban input edits, metadata edits, and fabricated outputs.
expected_solver_discovery: Use the policy file to align forecast method, service level, review-capacity, and budget behavior.
Treat short-history launch items differently from full-history items.
Protect near-term promo and launch exposure before lower-priority lines when the review set is capped.
Close the loop between forecast rows, accepted orders, remaining risks, and summary counts.

main_tests: required output files and exact column contract
forecast coverage across all in-scope store and SKU pairs plus profile-shaped checkpoints
focused replenishment plan checks for promo and launch protection under budget and review-capacity limits
summary and memo consistency for counts, budget, risks, and exceptions
guardrails: input bundle hash must remain unchanged
blocked and inactive pairs must never receive orders
launch-item analog handling and budget-held lines must stay visible in the output summary
promo uplift and post-promo dip must show up in the forecast output
the order set must stay focused instead of filling all possible low-priority lines
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill misses should concentrate on planning actions such as skipping launch protection, failing to keep the order set focused, missing promo prioritization, violating MOQ or case-pack rules, or dropping risk and exception carry-through.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every run starts from a fresh runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize the README until oracle passes and the with-skill versus without-skill comparison has collected complete task-level results.
experiment_protocol.review_basis: README aggregates pair20, pair21, and pair23 under the current final verifier logic. Pair20 already passed that logic as-run. Pair21 and pair23 with-skill outputs were reclassified because their old-verifier misses came only from checks later relaxed or removed in tests/test_outputs.py.
